sentences: Two graphics cards can both be sold as an RTX 30 50, and one is noticeably slower.
The 8 gigabyte version has 2,560 CUDA cores on a 128-bit memory bus.
The 6 gigabyte version has 2,304 cores on a 96-bit bus, so its bandwidth drops to 168 gigabytes per second.
It even uses a smaller chip.
It's built to draw 70 watts instead of 130.
Early benchmarks put it roughly twenty percent behind.
The clue is often tiny, like a "6G" buried in the product title.
Read the full model name, then look up that exact name on the maker's spec page.
The other six traps are in our video, 7 Black Friday PC Part Traps.
